title: Lancasters SMP
description: Server for players who love semi-vanilla survival. No pay-2-win, everything is open source for players who love development, or just like to play on server!
body:
![Server logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/77382d7221d3eb2e7be1a2e2f3f969d5dc5b2b97.png)

**Lancasters SMP** is a peaceful community survival server designed for players who enjoy a relaxed and friendly Minecraft experience. The server supports **multiple Minecraft versions (1.7+)**, allowing almost anyone to join.

We use **custom plugins and utilities** developed specifically for the server to improve gameplay while keeping the vanilla survival feel. These features add helpful mechanics, quality-of-life improvements, and unique systems you won’t find on most servers.

### ✨ Features
- 🛠 Custom server plugins
- 🌱 Peaceful and community-focused gameplay
- 🔌 Supports multiple Minecraft versions *(1.7+ compatible)*
- 👥 Friendly player environment
- ⚙️ Actively maintained and updated
- 🎉 Safe enviroment


Whether you want to **build, explore, trade, or collaborate with others**, Lancasters SMP provides a welcoming world where players can create and enjoy survival Minecraft together.

💬 **Join the community:**  
Discord: [---> JOIN THE COMMUNITY <---](https://discord.lancsmp.ru)

### We use whitelist.
You need to be first approved in discord. Else, you still can access all other servers like Creative and Anarchy


## Project used on this server
**[EssentialsLite](https://modrinth.com/plugin/essentialsl)**
